sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kv" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_name ON categories (name COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "price_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gst_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1800, "hsn" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "barcode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "min_stock_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "old_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE INDEX products_name ON products (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX products_barcode ON products (barcode) WHERE barcode <> ''
CREATE INDEX products_category ON products (category)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX products_old_id ON products (old_id) WHERE old_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_fts" USING fts5(name, barcode, content='products', content_rowid='rowid', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER products_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON products BEGIN INSERT INTO product_fts ("rowid", name, barcode) VALUES (new."rowid", new.name, new.barcode);END
CREATE TRIGGER products_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON products BEGIN INSERT INTO product_fts (product_fts, "rowid", name, barcode) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.name, old.barcode);END

CREATE TRIGGER products_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF name, barcode ON products BEGIN INSERT INTO product_fts (product_fts, "rowid", name, barcode) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.name, old.barcode);INSERT INTO product_fts ("rowid", name, barcode) VALUES (new."rowid", new.name, new.barcode);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "city" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "gstin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "credit_limit_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "old_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE INDEX customers_name ON customers (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE INDEX customers_phone ON customers (phone) WHERE phone <> ''
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_old_id ON customers (old_id) WHERE old_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dealers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "city" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "gstin" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "old_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE INDEX dealers_name ON dealers (name COLLATE NOCASE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dealers_old_id ON dealers (old_id) WHERE old_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT, "unit_cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_product ON stock_movements (product_id, at, qty_milli)
CREATE INDEX stock_movements_ref ON stock_movements (ref_id) WHERE ref_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_cache" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES products(id), "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "series" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "billed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT REFERENCES customers(id), "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "balance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "change_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "advance_kept_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cgst_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sgst_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "igst_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "round_off_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pay_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cancelled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "prices_include_gst" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "idem_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_bill_no" TEXT, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bills_number ON bills (number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bills_idem ON bills (idem_key)
CREATE INDEX bills_billed_at ON bills (billed_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX bills_customer ON bills (customer_id, billed_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX bills_old_no ON bills (old_bill_no) WHERE old_bill_no IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX bills_amount ON bills (total_paise DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX bills_seq ON bills (seq)
CREATE INDEX bills_open ON bills (billed_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE balance_paise > 0 AND cancelled = 0
CREATE INDEX bills_cancelled ON bills (billed_at DESC) WHERE cancelled = 1
CREATE INDEX bills_due ON bills (customer_id, billed_at) WHERE balance_paise > 0

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills(id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gst_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gross_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX bill_lines_bill ON bill_lines (bill_id, line_no)
CREATE INDEX bill_lines_product ON bill_lines (product_id, bill_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bill_cancellations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "bill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bills(id), "bill_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "by_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bill_cancellations_bill ON bill_cancellations (bill_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "estimations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "number" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "edited_on" INTEGER, "customer_id" TEXT REFERENCES customers(id), "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "converted_bill_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX estimations_number ON estimations (number)
CREATE INDEX estimations_at ON estimations (at DESC, id DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "estimation_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "estimation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES estimations(id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES products(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pcs', "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX estimation_lines_est ON estimation_lines (estimation_id, line_no)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "party_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bill_no" TEXT, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "by_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "mode" TEXT, "reverses" TEXT, "allocations" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "running_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ref_id" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX ledger_party ON ledger_entries (party_id, at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX ledger_bill ON ledger_entries (party_id, bill_no) WHERE bill_no IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX ledger_reverses ON ledger_entries (reverses) WHERE reverses IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "party_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "advance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "allocations" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "by_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payments_receipt ON payments (receipt_no)
CREATE INDEX payments_party ON payments (party_id, at DESC, id DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "party_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bill_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cancelled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX party_bills_key ON party_bills (party_id, bill_no)
CREATE INDEX party_bills_open ON party_bills (party_id, date) WHERE cancelled = 0 AND total_paise > paid_paise

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "party_balance" ("party_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "party_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "balance_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_bill_at" INTEGER, "last_payment_at" INTEGER, "entry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX party_balance_owed ON party_balance (party_kind, balance_paise DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_totals" ("day" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "bills" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sales_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "taxable_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cash_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "upi_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "card_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "credit_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cancelled_bills" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cancelled_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_month" ("product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "month" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(product_id, month));
CREATE INDEX product_month_by_month ON product_month (month, product_id, amount_paise)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "counters" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id), "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_due_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "by_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX reminders_customer ON reminders (customer_id, at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');
CREATE INDEX records_kind ON records (kind, at DESC, id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "coll" TEXT NOT NULL, "doc_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'set', "stamp" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT, "hold_until" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outbox_doc ON outbox (coll, doc_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_state ON outbox (state, seq)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "what" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "field" TEXT NOT NULL, "old_value" TEXT, "new_value" TEXT, "by_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX audit_at ON audit (at DESC)
